Heels on Wheels Monday Ride

Little Rock, AR · River Market

Heels on Wheels Monday Ride is a road and social group ride in Little Rock, AR. It meets every Monday, 5:30 pm, starting at William J. Clinton Presidential Library. Expect about 12–15 miles, beginner.

About the Heels on Wheels Monday Ride group ride

A women's cycling group with a beginner-pace Monday evening ride from the Clinton Library along the river trail. Twelve to 15 miles. The group also rides Thursday evenings from the Big Dam Bridge and Saturday mornings from the submarine in North Little Rock.
